verified_fact: Bhairava is the fierce manifestation of Shiva. Legend: Brahma's 5th head became arrogant and insulted Shiva. Bhairava appeared and cut off Brahma's 5th head. The skull (kapala) stuck to Bhairava's hand as punishment until he performed penance at Varanasi. Bhairava is considered the guardian (Kotwal) of Kashi.
voiceover_script: Brahma ke paanchwe sar pe ahankaar aa gaya — Shiv ko bura-bhala kaha! Tab Shiv ka ugra roop pragat hua — Kaal Bhairava! Paanchwa sar kat gaya. Wo khaopdi Bhairava ke haath se chipak gayi — papkaal dosha. Prayashchit ke liye Bhairava Kashi aaye. Kashi mein hi tha mukti ka dwaar. Aaj bhi Bhairava Kashi ke Kotwal hain — roz raat ki aarti ke baad unhe prashad diya jaata hai!
debate_question: Kashi ke Kotwal Kaal Bhairava ko aapne mana kiya?

The skull (kapala) stuck to Bhairava's hand as punishment until he performed penance at Varanasi. Bhairava is considered the guardian (Kotwal) of Kashi.
